events.headline: Iran says Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until US meets its conditions; disruption to Gulf shipping continues amid ongoing Iran-US/Israel conflict and Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure
US 30-year Treasury yield hits fresh 24-year high (~5.70%) on Oct 7, deepening a global bond selloff ahead of Fed minutes, as inflation, oil prices and fiscal concerns pressure rate-sensitive sectors

Nvidia shares hit a fresh all-time high (~$238.90-240) as the company nears a $6 trillion market cap, supported by continued AI-chip demand and a new $150B buyback; TSMC's Oct 15 earnings seen as the next catalyst for the AI/semis complex
